experiment_c_stability.small_denominator_caution: Each candidate represents 9.09% of the depressed dev cohort

experiment_d_candidate_characterization.finding: Candidates are overwhelmingly higher-severity PHQ-8 participants, not a distinct linguistic or acoustic subtype

verdict_and_answers.q2_details: Text and multimodal models significantly outperform dummy (R2=0.21-0.28 vs -0.00). Acoustic models do not outperform dummy (R2=-0.05 to 0.10).
verdict_and_answers.q3_details: Acoustic positive residuals (~8.3 pts) are ~100% explained by RTM and shrinkage. Text positive residuals (~5.7 pts) are partially dampened by genuine signal but still reflect RTM compression.
verdict_and_answers.q4_details: No. The subgroup overwhelmingly identifies the highest-scoring PHQ-8 participants whose residuals are mechanically larger due to global mean shrinkage.

q5_robust_vs_inconclusive.robust: Numerical reproducibility, text predictive signal, RTM mathematical coupling, acoustic lack of predictive signal.
q5_robust_vs_inconclusive.exploratory: Multimodal candidate overlap, candidate text keyword/topic exploration.
q5_robust_vs_inconclusive.inconclusive: Whether HSED reflects genuine emotional concealment, due to lack of ground truth masking labels, small sample size (N=11 dev), and whole-dialogue transcript limitation.

verdict_and_answers.q6_details: Proceeding directly to Phase 7 with the assumption that HSED is a clinically valid masking phenotype is NOT justified. However, treating discrepancy as an algorithmic difficulty-weighting reweighting mechanism can be investigated with strict exploratory disclaimers.
verdict_and_answers.q7_most_important_limitation: Lack of independent clinical masking ground truth combined with mathematical coupling between PHQ-8 target and residual definition.
verdict_and_answers.verdict_rationale: The positive discrepancy pattern among depressed participants and candidate subgroup selection are substantially explained by ordinary regression shrinkage toward the mean and target conditioning, perfectly matching a zero-information dummy baseline (p=0.43 for acoustic models vs permutation null).
